snapshot.description: Industria enclosure designed to house the official Raspberry Pi 7-inch Touch Display 2. Integrates the RPi display into the Industria industrial form factor.
features: Aluminum construction with rugged industrial-grade design
Passive heatsink with optional active cooling module
Full access to USB, Ethernet, HDMI, and GPIO ports
VESA, panel, and desktop mounting options
Compatible with Raspberry Pi HAT modules via GPIO
M.2 NVMe storage expansion support via PCIe
Official Raspberry Pi 7-inch Touch Display 2 integration
VESA, panel, and desktop mounting compatible
GPIO access supports Raspberry Pi HATs and Cytron Industrial HAT
Compatible with Argon Industria Communication modules
M.2 NVMe expansion board available as separate accessory
Rugged industrial-grade aluminum design with precision-machined hardware
Seamless integration into control panels and automation applications
